title: PersonaOffices
description: Declarative office layer over the org chart (purebliss single-tenant org: CEO/CTO/CFO/PMO). Each office binds a head persona (a role node in the tenant's org-chart.yaml), its member SME personas, its agent profiles (from an AgentPack team), its prompt module refs, a monthly budget (summed by reference from the org chart, never a bare literal) and its fleet/routing group. registry/personas/registry.py validate_offices() cross-checks every reference against the live persona library, the org chart and the routing config.

orgChartRef.description: Path (repo-relative) to the org-chart.yaml this office layer sits on top of.

headPersona.description: Persona id of the office head; must equal a role node id in orgChartRef.

memberPersonas.description: SME/specialist persona ids that report into this office (per persona-card.schema.json's reportsTo enum).

agentProfiles.description: AgentProfile ids (from the fleetPack) this office dispatches work through.

monthlyBudgetUsd.description: Must equal the sum of monthlyBudgetCapUsd of headPersona + every memberPersona role declared in the org chart / registry (source of truth stays the org chart; this is a computed, verified restatement, not a second literal).

budgetSource.description: Fixed pointer documenting where monthlyBudgetUsd is derived from, so no office can silently redefine a cap the org chart owns.
